items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Anytime he sits in the band and two of them go, and I was a leader knockoff, Trepanyeh go on and whatever time he picked up.

ctx.x: drummers? Bass class? Who were some of your favorite drummers? That'd be a good thing for you to know.

Now, Nanesh. Nanesh. Trepanyeh. Trepanyeh. That's my favorite drummer. He was better than Saeed. Saeed tell you that. Trepanyeh was another band who could read music, drum music. And he could tune his drum up, just like I'm telling you. Trepanyeh was a good drummer. He was what you call a clump. Anytime he sits in the band and two of them go, and I was a leader knockoff, Trepanyeh go on and whatever time he picked up. He's got that time. If you playing with him, he don't increase, and he don't decrease. He just…
I get tired of it. Every band sounds alike, every number sounds alike to me. Don't miss it. They can't help it. They play the same thing.
